Overview

Borås is a city in Västra Götaland with a population of 113,000. A textile and logistics hub in western Sweden, known for its zoo, recycling industry, and football culture. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
